intro_001.title: Problem Statement
intro_001.content: How do we efficiently create well-designed multi-agent agencies? Currently, creating a new agency in the CodeValdCortex platform requires: (1) Manual specification writing - Documenting introduction, goals, work items, roles; (2) Database setup - Creating agency-specific databases and collections; (3) Configuration generation - Writing JSON/YAML configuration files; (4) Workflow design - Defining how work flows through the agency; (5) RACI matrix construction - Mapping responsibilities across roles. This process is time-consuming (hours to days per agency), error-prone (inconsistent specifications), knowledge-intensive (requires deep platform understanding), and not scalable (can't quickly prototype agency designs).

intro_002.title: Solution Approach
intro_002.content: The Genesis Agency is a meta-agency—an agency whose work items are building other agencies. It is a self-contained agency with its own agents (Specification Designer, Requirements Analyst, etc.), follows standard agency workflows, and produces concrete deliverables (agency artifacts). The collaborative design process involves: human provides domain knowledge through keywords/documents, AI agents conduct structured research, iterative refinement through Q&A dialogue, and human reviews and approves specifications. It generates complete artifacts including agency specification (introduction, goals, work items, roles), database initialization scripts, workflow definitions, RACI matrix, and deployment manifests. Quality assurance is built-in with validation checks, consistency across all agency components, best practices enforced through templates, and human-in-the-loop verification points.

intro_004.title: Context
intro_004.content: CodeValdCortex is a multi-agent platform where agencies are collections of autonomous agents (AI and human) that collaborate to achieve goals. Key platform concepts include: Agency (organizational unit with goals, roles, and workflows), Agent (autonomous entity with specific capabilities), Work Item (actionable task progressing through workflows), Role (definition of agent capabilities and autonomy level L0-L4), Workflow (state machine defining work item progression), and RACI Matrix (maps roles to responsibilities). Currently deployed agencies include Water Distribution Network (UC-INFRA-001), Warehouse Management (UC-WMS-001), Financial Risk Analysis (UC-FRA-001), and Smart Logistics Platform (UC-LOG-001). Each was manually designed requiring significant effort. The technology stack includes Go backend (Gin framework), ArangoDB (graph database), AI Integration (OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude), Frontend (Templ templates, Alpine.js, Bulma CSS), and custom multi-agent orchestration. The Genesis Agency leverages the Research Prompt Framework (.github/prompts/research.prompt.md) which provides one-question-at-a-time exploration, explicit path selection (DEEPER/NOTE/NEXT/REVIEW), gap tracking system, periodic progress reviews, and red flag identification for inconsistencies.
